cand.title: FEDOPACC 2027
cand.excerpt: Destination fit is credible, but hotel sourcing and scale require verification.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Two verified association-side relationship contacts: Dra. Bethania Martínez Del Villar, organizing-committee president, who signs the invitation to strategic partners and sponsors; and Dra. Caroll Oller, committee vice president, a senior organizer for referral/escalation. Their commercial relevance follows from these roles; neither is publicly established as hotel contract signatory. Bco Congresos is the event-specific operational route, but no named 2027 accommodation planner was verified.
findings.futureEdition: Official event dates are 4–6 November 2027 in Punta Cana, Dominican Republic, within the requested horizon. These are activity dates displayed on the official home/welcome pages, not publication dates. No later edition through May 2028 was verified.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference using the supplied hotel specifications: Wyndham Alltra’s all-inclusive guestroom-led model fits the residential format evidenced by congress lodging packages, but its approximately 300-person conference capacity and 380 m² meeting inventory cannot be assumed adequate for the complete congress. The combined 2018 event reported 200 professionals and 40 exhibiting companies; the combined 2016 event reported 390 attendees and simultaneous sessions. Neither is a 2027 forecast or room count. Exhibition footprint, breakouts and 2027 attendance must be established before any full-event pitch. This is core Punta Cana/Bávaro demand, but Uvero Alto accommodation would be off-site from the committed Bávaro venue.
findings.venueCommitments: The official accommodation page explicitly designates Barceló Bávaro Palace, Playa Bávaro KM 1 no 1, Punta Cana, as hotel sede and official hotel. It publishes negotiated congress all-inclusive rates and urges delegates to book there. This is an announced competing host-hotel commitment, not merely a preferred-hotel listing; the underlying contract, exclusivity and inventory allocation are not public.
findings.historicalRotation: Verified regional series anchors: first congress, 6–8 December 2006 (destination/hotel not verified in the event listing); sixth regional congress, 15–17 June 2016, Hotel Real Intercontinental, San José, Costa Rica; seventh, 15–17 November 2018, Punta Cana, venue printed as Barcelon Convention Center. The 2027 edition returns to Punta Cana with Barceló Bávaro Palace announced. This establishes multiple editions and a change of destination, not an annual cycle or a guaranteed rotation back to the Dominican Republic. Intervening 2022–2026 editions were not verified.
findings.accommodationSourcing: 2027 official lodging is already directed to Barceló Bávaro Palace through the congress registration/accommodation pathway. Published tax-inclusive all-inclusive room rates per night: single junior suite USD 255; double USD 300 total; triple USD 405 total. Group registration, agency-group requests and booking changes are routed to Bco technical secretariat at fedopacc2027@bcocongresos.com, +34 93 882 38 78. Additional-hotel procurement status is unknown; no open RFP, room-block quantity or overflow requirement was found. Published booking facilities do not mean hotel procurement is open.
findings.organizationStructure: FEDOPACC is a regional professional federation, described in a founder biography as Federación Centroamericana y del Caribe de Asociaciones de Dolor y Cuidados Paliativos. This is a scientific/association congress, not evidenced as a corporate incentive. The 2027 committee is distinct from Bco Congresos, explicitly the organizing agency/technical secretariat. Bco describes itself as the PCO of Ávoris Corporación Empresarial. The 2018 congress was organized by Dominican association ADETDYCP with FEDOPACC coordination; that historical role does not establish the 2027 legal contracting entity. Barceló Bávaro Palace is the announced host hotel, not the event owner.
findings.competitiveLimitations: Barceló has the advertised host hotel, negotiated all-inclusive rates and on-site networking proposition. Nonresident delegates may attend but must pay an additional USD 105 plus 28% tax for congress A&B, described on the registration page as covering the congress days, not as a per-day charge. That page explicitly says it is not a general hotel day pass. Inference: an alternative hotel adds an A&B charge and off-site transport complexity. Bco’s own corporate description places it in Ávoris/Grupo Barceló, an additional relationship consideration, not proof of exclusivity or procurement bias. No sourced sellout, overflow or unmet-room evidence was located.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Contact the Bco technical secretariat at fedopacc2027@bcocongresos.com / +34 93 882 38 78; acknowledge Barceló Bávaro Palace as the 2027 host. Ask for the named accommodation/project manager and whether any additional hotels, sponsor groups or pre/post packages are being sourced. Request actual 2027 attendance, peak rooms, stay pattern, exhibition/breakout footprint and off-site transport requirements before pricing. Request an introduction to Bethania Martínez Del Villar and Caroll Oller for future host-selection discussions. If there is no unmet requirement, retain as a relationship-development account, not a 2027 room-block opportunity.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: For the selected 2027 edition, delegate registration and nonresident attendance are explicitly contemplated, but host-hotel replacement is not a demonstrated opportunity. Alltra should not count the congress as available contracted room demand. Any accommodation capture is conditional on organizer-approved additional lodging, an independently booked group, or pre/post stays; none is currently verified as demand.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: verified earlier regional editions justify relationship development for later host-selection cycles, not a dated future lead. No post-2027 edition, bidding timetable, hotel RFP or Dominican return commitment was verified. Seek smaller residential scientific programmes or a later edition only after confirming destination, attendance, exhibition and meeting-space requirements. Do not label the series annual or forecast a 2028 edition.
